roman=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(base,'roman_cities.csv'))
world=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(base,'worldcities.csv'))
print(roman[['Start Date','End Date']].describe(include='all'))
print('start counts',roman['Start Date'].value_counts(dropna=False).head(15))
print('end missing',roman['End Date'].isna().mean(),'date range',roman['Start Date'].min(),roman['Start Date'].max(),roman['End Date'].min(),roman['End Date'].max())
print('world pop',world.population.describe(percentiles=[.5,.9,.95,.99]))
print('missing coords roman',roman[['Longitude (X)','Latitude (Y)']].isna().sum().to_dict(),'world',world[['lat','lng','population']].isna().sum().to_dict())
print(world.dtypes)
print('city population >100k',sum(world.population>100000))

from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
rcoords=roman[['Latitude (Y)','Longitude (X)']].to_numpy()
w=world[(world.population>100000)&world.population.notna()].copy()
wcoords=w[['lat','lng']].to_numpy()
tree=cKDTree(rcoords)
dist,ix=tree.query(wcoords,k=1)
print('within euclidean degree <= .1', (dist<=.1).sum())
print('within box each <= .1', ((abs(wcoords[:,0]-rcoords[ix,0])<=.1)&(abs(wcoords[:,1]-rcoords[ix,1])<=.1)).sum())
print('within .1 lat only and lon scaled geodesic rough?')
print('all with euclidean:', w.loc[dist<=.1,['city','country','population','lat','lng']].sort_values('country').to_string(index=False)[:3500])

import numpy as np
lat1=np.radians(wcoords[:,0]); lon1=np.radians(wcoords[:,1])
lat2=np.radians(rcoords[:,0]); lon2=np.radians(rcoords[:,1])
mins=[]
for a,b in zip(lat1,lon1):
    hav=np.sin((a-lat2)/2)**2 + np.cos(a)*np.cos(lat2)*np.sin((b-lon2)/2)**2
    mins.append(2*np.arcsin(np.sqrt(np.clip(hav,0,1))).min()*180/np.pi)
mins=np.array(mins)
print('great circle angular <=.1', (mins<=.1).sum())
print('box',((abs(wcoords[:,0]-rcoords[ix,0])<=.1)&(abs(wcoords[:,1]-rcoords[ix,1])<=.1)).sum())
print('differences euclid-vs-great-circle', ((dist<=.1)!=(mins<=.1)).sum())
